profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer specializing in distributed systems, Go, and Python

highlights: Led migration of monolith to microservices on Kubernetes, reducing deploy time from 2h to 8min
Built internal rate-limiting service handling 50k req/s in Go
Built payments API in Python/Django processing $2M/month

summary_template: Jane Doe is a Senior Backend Engineer with 6 years of experience specializing in distributed systems using Go and Python. Currently at Acme Corp, she led a monolith-to-microservices migration on Kubernetes that reduced deploy time from 2 hours to 8 minutes and built a high-throughput rate-limiting service in Go handling 50k req/s. Previously at Globex Inc, she developed a Python/Django payments API processing $2M monthly. She holds a B.S. in Computer Science from the University of Texas at Austin.
